data.subject: Local Ledger for PMC FIG
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in FINW and BMRC.

FINW's Q2 2026 total interest income was $34.0M versus $19.7M a year earlier, up 72.1% year over year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1856365/000185636526000106/0001856365-26-000106-index.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, and filings), with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
